messages:
maria: Heads-up — saw an IAM path-filter tighten that is rejecting the ephemeral role used by GPU nodes in us-west-3; node joins failing.
ops-bot: Alert: iam/path-filter-change detected for prod-usw3 at 2026-03-23T12:01:05Z. policy_id=pf-0192
kevin: Copy. Any evidence it's the path-filter and not an expired STS grant?
maria: Checked CloudTrail + authz logs. Deny entries show Condition StringLike on iam:ResourcePath matching rejected role ARN. example deny snippet: 
```json
{
  "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ephemeral/llm-node-usw3",
  "Condition": {"StringLike": {"iam:ResourcePath": "/ephemeral/llm-*"}}
}
```
olivia: That looks like yesterday's audit-hardening rollout. Did security change the allowed prefix? :eyes: 
natalie: Yeah, PR #987 landed. Intention was to restrict but a staging->prod transform collapsed the wildcard; our new node role path `/ephemeral/llm-node-usw3` doesn't match the tightened shape. sorry folks.
sam: Impact: ~30 pending GPU joins in usw3 stuck, warm pool draining, batching latency up ~2.3x, a few customer tails increasing.
maria: Can we emergency allowlist the concrete role ARN until we fix the pattern? Avoids full rollback.
kevin: I can patch policy to include explicit Resource ARNs in the allowlist and push via terraform. prepping change now.
security-bot: @kevin triggered infra-ci/job/6423 for policy patch.
kevin: CI green; applying policy change to prod-usw3.
ops-bot: Policy pf-0192 updated in prod-usw3 by kevin at 2026-03-23T12:03:22Z.
sam: Nodes are starting to join — warm pool +3 within 2 mins, latency backlog decreasing.
maria: Good. Next: natalie to update PR to use explicit pattern matching + unit test for iam:ResourcePath shapes; olivia to sweep other regions; kevin to run post-deploy audit.
natalie: Opening follow-up PR to change pattern to `/ephemeral/llm-node-*` and include allowed role ARNs. Adding integration test against staging authz logs.
olivia: I'll run a sweep over regions for similar naming mismatches.
maria: Filing short postmortem in Confluence and tagging infra/security. If you see new denies, ping here. :thumbsup:
